components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; border: none; transition: background 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Cyan-tinted pill, e.g. chatbot suggested prompts.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1); color: #67e8f9; border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.2); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: rgba(34,211,238,0.2); }

components.name: Glass Nav
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 32px; } .ds-nav-item { color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { background: #475569; color: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Chat Launcher (FAB)
components.description: Signature floating action button with the Online Emerald status ring — the site's one deliberate liveness signal.
components.css: .ds-fab { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #06b6d4, #34d399); border: 3px solid #10b981; color: #ffffff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(16,185,129,0.4); transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover, .ds-fab:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(16,185,129,0.8); } .ds-fab-status { position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: -4px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 3px solid #0f172a; background: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,0.8); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Floating glass surface — chat window, focused-section overlay.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(2,6,23,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }

narrative.overview: The site reads as instrumentation floating in near-black space: gradients fall from slate to pure black, glass panels hover above that void with backdrop blur, and small glowing signals (an emerald "online" pulse, a cyan highlight) report that the system is live rather than decorative. The personality is confident and technical — restraint carries the weight, not ornament. Every glow, pill, and pulse is functional: it tells the visitor something (this is clickable, this is live, this is currently focused), never purely decorative. This system explicitly rejects the generic templated-portfolio look: no stock hero-plus-card-grid, no flat white cards, nothing that reads like a resume PDF turned into a webpage. Depth comes from the void-to-glass relationship, not from card borders or drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black gradient depth (slate-900 → black) as the base plane, glass panels floating above it
Three narrow, purposeful accent roles — Signal Blue, Console Cyan, Online Emerald — never blended into a rainbow
Colored glow in place of hard black shadows
Full-round shapes for anything interactive (pills, avatars, the chat launcher); generous but not maximal rounding for panels
Motion that signals liveness (pulse, hover-scale) rather than choreography for its own sake

rules.name: The Three-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only three accent colors exist: Signal Blue (action), Console Cyan (highlight), Online Emerald (status). A fourth accent hue is never introduced without retiring one of these.

rules.name: The Glass-Border Rule
rules.body: Panel borders are translucent white (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), never a solid neutral gray — the border should read as light catching an edge, not a drawn line.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Every text role uses the same system sans stack. A second family is never introduced for "flavor" — hierarchy is weight and size only.

rules.name: The Colored-Glow Rule
rules.body: When an element is meant to feel "live" (the chat launcher, the online status dot), its shadow is a tinted glow in the element's own accent color, never a neutral black shadow.

dos: Do keep accent color to the three named roles (Signal Blue, Console Cyan, Online Emerald) — each with one job.
Do use colored glow instead of black drop shadows on anything meant to feel live or interactive.
Do use full-round shapes for every interactive, tappable element (buttons, avatars, chips, the chat launcher).
Do keep borders translucent white (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), never solid gray.
Do let the system sans stack carry the whole hierarchy through weight and size alone.
donts: Don't ship a generic templated-portfolio layout — no stock hero-plus-card-grid-of-projects that reads as bootcamp-issue.
Don't make it feel overly corporate or stiff — nothing that reads like a resume PDF reformatted as a webpage.
Don't introduce a fourth accent hue without retiring one of the existing three.
Don't use a second font family "for flavor" — one system sans stack, weight and size only.
Don't use Online Emerald for anything other than a live/available status signal — its rarity is what makes it legible.
Don't add hard black drop shadows to glass panels — depth comes from blur + translucent border + colored glow, not from shadow-black.
